ns2:section.sectionText: This course is primarily asynchronous with 2 weekly required small group meetings for 1 hour on Tuesdays and 1.5 hours on Thursdays. Meeting time options will include T/R 2pm; T/R 6pm. Additional meeting times may be made available pending enrollment numbers. All times are CST. For textbook information or other questions about the course, please reach out to Professor Amy Clay aclay@illinois.edu
